relevance_note: Case report of a boy and his mother carrying a PSTPIP1 variant: "the pathogenic mutation c.688 G > A (p. Ala230Thr) in the PSTPIP1 gene present in the patient and in the mother".
method_note: Hand extraction from the text; no tables in the paper. Two in-scope people: the index boy, labelled 'patient' (rule 5; the paper calls him 'the patient'/'the index patient'), and his mother, labelled 'mother of patient' (rule 2). The paper calls both 'two related patients with PAPA syndrome'; 'other members of the family have not yet been genetically investigated' and the mother's 'similar cases in the family' give no individual-level detail, so no further rows. Contradiction/inconsistency on the boy's onset: the abstract says recurrent pyoarthritis 'since the age of 5 years and 8 months', while the case text says the elbow trauma/pyoarthritis was 'At the age of 5 years'; the abstract age is used for age_at_onset and the case-text age for the elbow feature onset. Odontogenic abscesses and sinusitis at age 4 are recorded as features but not used for age at onset or for the 'skin or soft-tissue abscesses'/'recurrent infections' checklist items (not stated as skin abscesses or as recurrent). Age at report: abstract gives '7-year-and-3-month-old', case text '7-year-old', and later 'at the age of 8'; last evaluation recorded as 'at the age of 8'. The MRI 'focus of incipient osteomyelitis' is hedged ('may have corresponded'), so not recorded as a feature; the osteomyelitis checklist item is marked observed from the Discussion's 'bone alterations mimicking osteomyelitis, as presented in our patient'. 'he never evaluated to sepsis' is unclear wording and was not recorded. Zygosity heterozygous from 'both harboring the A230 T heterozygous mutation'. Variant type not recorded: 'missense mutations' in the abstract refers to PAPA in general, not this variant. Boy's inheritance recorded as inherited maternal because the mother carries the same variant; the father's testing is not reported. Mother's inheritance not reported. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (paper does not say; 'already reported mutation' refers to the variant).
